$comment: THE declaration of omx-pitch, the folder's one hand-written file. Every other file of the folder is generated from it by tools/gen.mjs. Its parameters are by reference to omx-contract's pitch kernel and bind by name to omx-dsp's instance face. Parameter order is append-only.
name: omx pitch
description: The console's pitch shifter: shifts both channels up or down by semitones and cents, without changing their length, mixed with the dry signal.

console.$comment: The console has the pitch stage in its walk (packages/declarations/stages/pitch.json, its presents null) and draws no panel, chip or card for it today; racked as a plugin it is drawn by the generic plugin editor.
